info.title: Movetrics Cloud API
info.description:
Your own recordings and results, read with an access token from Account on the web.

Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer mvt_…`. Excel's Get Data > From Web has no bearer field: choose Basic, any
user name, and the token as the password. A token reads one workspace with its owner's current role and the
workspace's export rule. Without names, athletes appear by a stable code and titles and file names are left out.

Samples come out exactly as stored, unfiltered. Every result names its metric, method and method version and the
engine version, so your own calculation can be compared line by line. The contract is additive within v1: fields
may be added, never renamed or removed.
